update_samples.stem: Why didn't the United States and Australia sign the Kyoto Protocol to slash greenhouse gasses by 5.2 percent before 2012?
Earthquake prediction at early and short time periods today is on a __________ basis.
Why were the various regions of the country created as subdivisions of the nation?
When you judge by results regardless of your relations to the people involved, which Filipino trait do you counteract?
if you keep seeing your way of doing things as the right way and everybody else's as the wrong way, you tend to have the attitude called __________.
On what basis is the caste system of social structure and stratification?
Which is considered as positive or favorable consequences of tough competition?
The Chinese minority group in the Philippines adopts the language, history, and manners of mainstream Filipino culture as its own. What pattern of interaction occurs?
Which illustrate horizontal mobility in the social ladder?
Karl Marx divided industrial society into bourgeoisie and proletariat. What was one of his major bases of classification?
Which of the following may result at the departure country when Filipino professionals emigrate to other countries?
If a Catholic researcher makes a study on polygamy as practiced in Islam, what influence will likely add subjectivity to his/her findings?
If government sponsors a research on social poverty, what factor will likely influence the research?
What attitude is needed before one engages in data-gathering for research?
When are laws said to be unscientific? When laws ________.
How should social scientist view culture?
Color, emblem, gestures, designs, words are part of __________ language that makes man different from animals.
The value marker of ___________ is conveyed by the EDSA people power revolution.
What issue is controversial for church people but is a need of secular society?
Which can explain the fact that we still observe the nod of respect (mano po) to our elders as our forebears?
What constitutional reform did Filipino constitutionalists including those who framed the Malolos Constitution introduce to eliminate the dominance of the church over the state?
What could you accept as true from the varied propositions of Herbert Spencer?
The following facts show Emile Durkheim has reason to assume that individuals are products, not creators of society EXCEPT __________.
Which explains Spencer's theory of progressive evolution of human societies?
If there is anything positive in "ningas-cogon" Filipino trait, which one?
